effective_strategy.volume_rule: 15m volume > 20-period volume SMA; config volume_multiplier=1.5 is not active
effective_strategy.regime_role: direction filter only; selector does not switch to a distinct strategy
effective_strategy.universe_policy: config symbols, maximum five concurrent positions globally

execution_assumptions.entry: market order; strategy price is expected 15m close, not guaranteed fill
execution_assumptions.monitoring: polling loop, configured interval 60 seconds, ticker-based local monitoring
execution_assumptions.paper_intrabar: ticker close only; no historical high/low sequence
execution_assumptions.live_protection: SL/TP placement attempted after market fill but not critical in current code
execution_assumptions.backtest: 1h loop, divergent sizing/exits, close-based exit, no fees/slippage/funding

known_defects_at_freeze: Independent iloc[-2] selection without one decision timestamp or freshness contract
Warm-up policy is not valid per indicator/timeframe
Indicator implementations diverge between data, indicators, and backtest modules
Backtest runs at 1h cadence and contains future/current-candle and divergent execution semantics
Paper TP1 can retrigger, uses fixed leverage, and its balance/PnL records do not match OrderManager accounting
Live protection placement is non-critical and Live TP1 does not reliably recreate TP2
Sizing logic exists in both Strategy and RiskManager; main bot and Backtest use different paths
Daily loss/consecutive loss state is in memory and partial exits are treated as independent results
Local order/position state is not fully reconciled or hydrated after restart
Database is best-effort and lacks a durable lifecycle/event/fill journal
Existing tests are smoke/shape tests and have not established parity or statistical validity
